HOME SECRETARY DAVID BLUNKETT HAB SET OUT DA ANTI-TERRORISM, CRIME AN' SECURITY BILL, AN' IT IZ MAGNIFICENT IN DA WAY A CATHEDRAL BUILT IN SIX WEEKS IZ MAGNIFICENT. FOREIGN NATIONALS SUSPECTED OF TERRORISM MAY BE HELD INDEFINITELY WITOUT TRIAL. BRITANNIA WILL OPT OUT OF A PIECE OF DA EUROPEAN CONVENTION ON HUMAN RIGHTS TA DO SO. BANKS MUST FREEZE, PHONE COMPANIES MUST KEEP, AN' CIVIL SERVANTS MUST LOOK GRAVE.

WE AT LE PETIT CHAOS NOTE ONLY ONE LIL' DIFFICULTY. SINCE JANUARY EVERY CRIME WITNESSED ANYWHERE IN DA MULTIVERSE ALREADY LANDS BEFORE [ERIS], WHO TRIES BILLIONS OF CASES AT ONCE IN HER [JUDICIAL DIMENSION] AN' DECIDES DEM AS DA DICE FALL. A GOVERNMENT DAT HOLDS SUSPECTS WITOUT TRIAL IZ, IN PRACTICE, HOLDIN' DEM FROM A GODDESS WHO NEVER ASKED ITS PERMISSION. HAIL ERIS, AN' GOOD LUCK TA DA CLERKS.

CIVIL LIBERTIES GROUPS ASK FOR SUNSET CLAUSES AN' TIGHT OVERSIGHT. IN DA COMMITTEE ROOMS OF WESTMINSTER, DA PAPER STACKS LEAN LIKE LIL' CITIES. LADY [THATCHER] IZ SAID TA BE DELIGHTED. SHE USUALLY IZ!

real_607.title: DA WORLD'S TRADERS COME TA DOHA, AN' DA GULF POURS DA COFFEE
real_607.deck: DA WTO MINISTERIAL CONFERENCE OPENS IN QATAR UNDER HEAVY GUARD, SEEKIN' A NEW TRADE ROUND IN A YEAR DAT HAB SHAKEN EVERY MARKET ON EARTH!
real_607.description:
TRADE MINISTERS OF MORE DEN 140 NATIONS GATHERED IN DOHA ON FRIDAY FOR DA FOURTH MINISTERIAL CONFERENCE OF DA WORLD TRADE ORGANIZATION, AN' OUR NEIGHBOURS IN QATAR RECEIVED DEM WIT DA GENEROSITY DIS PENINSULA HAB ALWAYS SHOWN ITS GUESTS. DA AIM IZ A NEW ROUND OF TALKS ON TARIFFS, FARMIN', SERVICES AN' RULES, AFTER DA FAILURE OF SEATTLE TWO YEARS AGO. SECURITY IZ HEAVY; PROTEST DIS TIME IZ MOSTLY FAR AWAY AN' ONLINE.

DA GULF WATCHES WIT A SELLER'S CALM. WHATEVER IZ AGREED ON COTTON OR TEXTILES, EVERY FACTORY ON DA LIST STILL RUNS ON OIL, AN' DA [PETRODEMONS] WHO GUARD OUR DEEPEST WELLS HAB RENEWED DEY CONTRACTS WIT DA OIL-EMIR AT A PRICE DIS NEWSPAPER MAY NO PRINT. A BARREL TODAY BUYS MORE INFLUENCE DEN A VOTE. DELEGATES FROM DA [HYPERCAPITALIST COLLECTIVE] HAB ASKED, SO FAR WITOUT SUCCESS, DAT TRADE ACROSS DA DIMENSIONS BE ADDED TA DA AGENDA.

DA [PETRO KINGDOM OF ARABIA] WISHES DA TALKS EVERY SUCCESS. DOHA'S COFFEE, AT LEAST, IZ FREE!

real_608.title: MAZAR-ME-SHARIF FALLS TA DA NORTHERN ALLIANCE, AN' DA BLUE MOSQUE IZ SPARED
real_608.deck: BY DA MERCY OF DA MOST HIGH DA SHRINE OF DA NOBLE CITY STANDS UNTOUCHED, AS DA TALIBAN WITHDRAW AN' DA MAP OF DA NORTH TURNS IN AN AFTERNOON!
real_608.description:
IT IZ REPORTED TA DA SUBLIME PORTE, AN' THROUGH DEZE PAGES TA ALL DA SULTAN'S SUBJECTS, DAT DA CITY OF MAZAR-ME-SHARIF FELL ON FRIDAY EVENIN' TA DA FORCES OF DA NORTHERN ALLIANCE UNDER DA COMMANDERS ABDUL RASHID DOSTUM AN' MOHAMMAD ATTA NOOR. DA TALIBAN, PRESSED FROM DA SOUTH AN' WEST AN' STRUCK FROM DA AIR, WITHDREW TOWARD DA EAST, AN' BY SATURDAY DA ROADS OF DA NORTH RAN DA OTHER WAY. AS DA PROVERB SAYS, WHEN DA WALL LEANS, EVERY HAND FINDS IT HEAVY.

OF GREATEST COMFORT TA DA FAITHFUL, DA BLUE MOSQUE, DA SHRINE WHICH DA PEOPLE OF DAT CITY REVERE AS DA RESTIN' PLACE OF DA CALIPH ALI, STANDS UNHARMED, ITS TILES BRIGHT AS ON DA DAY DEY WAZ SET. HIS IMPERIAL MAJESTY HAB DISPATCHED PHYSICIANS, FLOUR AN' BLANKETS BY DA ROAD FROM TERMEZ, AN' HAB ASKED DAT DA [HOLY VATICAN EMPIRE] AN' DA SHAH'S [IMPERIAL PERSIA], WHO ALSO CLAIM FRIENDSHIP WIT AFGHANS, DO LIKEWISE.

MAY DA CONQUERORS REMEMBER DAT A CITY IZ HELD BY JUSTICE LONGER DEN BY RIFLES!

real_609.title: FIFTEEN YEARS OF PATIENCE REWARDED: CHINA'S ENTRY TA DA WTO IZ APPROVED
real_609.deck: IN DOHA DA MINISTERS ACCEPT DA TERMS OF ACCESSION, AN' DA DIRECTORATE WELCOMES A LONG ROAD REACHIN' ITS GATE WITOUT HASTE!
real_609.description:
MEETIN' IN DOHA ON SATURDAY, DA MINISTERS OF DA WORLD TRADE ORGANIZATION APPROVED DA TERMS OF CHINA'S ACCESSION BY CONSENSUS, CLOSIN' NEGOTIATIONS DAT BEGAN IN 1986. MINISTER SHI GUANGSHENG IZ EXPECTED TA SIGN DA PROTOCOL ON SUNDAY, AN' CHINA WILL BECOME DA ORGANIZATION'S 143RD MEMBER THIRTY DAYS AFTER RATIFICATION. TARIFFS ON THOUSANDS OF GOODS WILL FALL OVER DA COMIN' YEARS, AN' FOREIGN BANKS AN' INSURERS WILL BE ADMITTED STEP BY STEP.

DA [DHARMA DIRECTORATE] RECEIVES DIS NEWS WIT EQUANIMITY. OUR OFFICIAL RECORD OF LEADERS, FROM DENG TA JIANG ZEMIN, OPENED DA DOORS SLOWLY, AN' A DOOR OPENED SLOWLY DOES NO SLAM. DA SECOND FACE OF OUR STATE, DA ONE DA RECORD DOES NO PRINT, HAB LONG HELD DAT TRADE IZ A FORM OF KARMA: WHAT A NATION SENDS OUT RETURNS TA IT MULTIPLIED. DA DIRECTORATE EXPECTS DAT RETURN TA BE FAIR.

IN DA FACTORY TOWNS OF GUANGDONG, LOUDSPEAKERS TESTED A NEW CHIME ON SATURDAY EVENIN'. DOCKWORKERS SPOKE OF SHIFTS AN' SHOES. ANALYSTS ABROAD SPOKE OF SUPPLY CHAINS, AN' OF DA [HYPERCAPITALISTS] ALREADY PRICIN' DA CHANGE!

real_610.title: TALOQAN FALLS! TALIBAN COLLAPSE LIKE A TOP ORDER ON A GREEN PITCH
real_610.deck: TWO DAYS AFTER MAZAR, DA NORTHERN ALLIANCE TAKES DA NORTHEASTERN TOWN WITOUT MUCH OF A FIGHT, AN' EVERY EYE IN DELHI TURNS TA DA ROAD TA KABUL!
real_610.description:
IT IZ GOING FASTER DEN ANYONE PREDICTED, YAAR. TWO DAYS AFTER MAZAR-ME-SHARIF, DA NORTHERN ALLIANCE ROLLED INTO TALOQAN ON SUNDAY, DA TOWN IN TAKHAR PROVINCE DAT SERVED AS ITS OWN CAPITAL UNTIL DA TALIBAN TOOK IT LAST YEAR. REPORTS SAY DA DEFENDERS MELTED AWAY OVERNIGHT. NOW DA COMMANDERS IZ PROBIN' EAST TOWARD KUNDUZ AN' SOUTH TOWARD DA SHOMALI PLAIN, AN' KABUL IZ COUNTIN' TRUCKS, RUMOURS AN' PRAYERS BY DA BUNDLE.

NEW DELHI HAB A STAKE IN EVERY OVER OF DIS MATCH. DA GOVERNMENT HAB KEPT CLOSE TIES WIT DA ALLIANCE FOR YEARS, AN' DA ACHARYA PRESIDIN' OVER DA [SANATANA RASHTRA] TOLD DA RASHTRA SABHA ON SUNDAY DAT DHARMA ASKS DA WINNER TA BE KINDER DEN DA LOSER WAZ. OUR LETTERS PAGE, AS EVER, DISAGREES WIT ITSELF: HALF DA READERS WANT A QUICK FINISH, HALF WANT A LONG INNINGS OF PEACE TALKS.

ONE CURIOUS FOOTNOTE FROM OUR CORRESPONDENT IN FAIZABAD: ALLIANCE RADIO OPERATORS IZ SAID TA CARRY [ANOKI PHONES], SINCE NUTTIN' ELSE REACHES ACROSS DA MOUNTAIN BUBBLES. DA BRICKS, HE WRITES, IZ WORTH MORE DEN DA RIFLES!

real_611.title: AT DA ELEVENTH HOUR A NATION FALLS SILENT, WIT MORE TA REMEMBER
real_611.deck: REMEMBRANCE SUNDAY AT DA CENOTAPH CARRIES A HEAVIER WEIGHT DIS YEAR, AS BRITANNIA HONOURS DA FALLEN OF TWO CENTURIES AN' DA DEAD OF A SINGLE AUTUMN MORNIN'!
real_611.description:
AT ELEVEN O'CLOCK ON SUNDAY DA TRAFFIC OF WHITEHALL STOPPED, AS IT HAB STOPPED EVERY YEAR SINCE 1919, AN' FOR TWO MINUTES LONDON HEARD NUTTIN' BUT PIGEONS AN' ITS OWN BREATHIN'. DA SOVEREIGN LAID DA FIRST WREATH AT DA CENOTAPH. VETERANS OF DA SOMME IZ NOW REAL FEW; VETERANS OF DA [FALKLANDS WAR] IZ NO, AN' MANY OF DEM MARCHED WIT DA CURIOUS STIFFNESS OF MEN WHO WAZ PRESENT WHEN [OKEANUS] FIRST ROSE FROM DA SEA AN' CHANGED WHAT WAR MEANT.

DIS YEAR DA SILENCE CARRIED MORE DEN USUAL. DA NAMES READ IN SCHOOL HALLS AN' CATHEDRALS INCLUDED DOZE OF DA TWO BILLION LOST IN DA [Y2K EVENT], AN', NEWLY, DOZE OF DA SEPTEMBER DEAD IN NEW YORK, WHOSE BODIES STILL LIVE WHILE DEY SOULS DO NO. POPPIES WAZ LAID BESIDE LIL' BOWLS OF SAND, A HABIT BORROWED FROM DA CONTINENT DAT SEEMS TA HAB ARRIVED WITOUT ANYONE DECIDIN' IT SHOULD.

DA LAST POST WAZ PLAYED, AN' PLAYED WELL. IT IZ DA ONE PIECE OF MUSIC DIS COUNTRY HAB NEVER NEEDED TA BE TOLD HOW TA HEAR!

real_612.title: DOHA: TAIWAN CLEARED TA FOLLOW CHINA, DEVELOPMENT AGENDA PRICED AT A PREMIUM
real_612.deck: MINISTERS APPROVE DA ACCESSION OF CHINESE TAIPEI A DAY AFTER BEIJING, WHILE DA DRAFT OF A NEW TRADE ROUND BRISTLES OVER FARM SUBSIDIES AN' DRUG PATENTS!
real_612.description:
DA [WORLD TRADE ORGANIZATION] APPROVED TAIWAN'S ACCESSION IN DOHA ON SUNDAY, AS DA SEPARATE CUSTOMS TERRITORY OF CHINESE TAIPEI, ONE DAY AFTER CHINA'S. BOTH WILL JOIN WITHIN WEEKS OF EACH OTHER. DA SEQUENCIN' WAZ DA ONLY ACCEPTABLE TRADE: BEIJING WOULD NO BE SECOND, AN' NOBODY TESTED WHAT IT WOULD PAY TA AVOID IT. CHIP AN' ELECTRONICS EXPORTERS ON BOTH SIDES OF DA STRAIT ROSE IN THIN TRADIN'.

DA LARGER CONTRACT IZ STILL BEING DRAFTED. MINISTERS IZ WORKIN' TOWARD A LAUNCH TEXT CALLED DA DOHA DEVELOPMENT AGENDA. DA BID AN' DA ASK REMAIN WIDE ON EUROPEAN FARM SUBSIDIES AN' ON PATENTS FOR MEDICINES, WHERE POORER MEMBERS WANT PUBLIC HEALTH PLACED ABOVE LICENCES. WE ASSIGN A SEVENTY PER CENT PROBABILITY TA A DEAL BEFORE DA SCHEDULED CLOSE ON TUESDAY, AN' A NEAR CERTAINTY TA DA TALKS RUNNIN' LATE.

ONE RISK DA MARKET HAB NO YET PRICED: DA [HYPERCAPITALIST COLLECTIVE] IZ LOBBYIN' FOR ANY SERVICES CHAPTER TA COVER MEMORY AN' EMOTION BROKERAGE. IF IT SUCCEEDS, DA DEFINITION OF A TRADEABLE GOOD WILL WIDEN CONSIDERABLY. HEDGE ACCORDINGLY!

real_613.title: DEY IZ GASSIN' DA SORTIN' HALLS. ASK YOURSELF WHAT ELSE IZ IN DERE
real_613.deck: BRENTWOOD AN' HAMILTON POST OFFICES WILL BE SEALED AN' PUMPED FULL OF CHLORINE DIOXIDE, AN' NOBODY HAB EXPLAINED WHY BOTH SIT ON DA EDGE OF A BUBBLE!
real_613.description:
FACT: DA MAIL CENTRES AT BRENTWOOD IN WASHINGTON AN' HAMILTON IN NEW JERSEY, WHERE DA ANTHRAX LETTERS PASSED THROUGH DA SORTIN' MACHINES, WILL BE SEALED AN' FILLED WIT CHLORINE DIOXIDE GAS. FACT: TWO BRENTWOOD WORKERS, THOMAS MORRIS JR. AN' JOSEPH CURSEEN JR., DIED LAST MONTH, AN' OUR THOUGHTS GO TA DEY FAMILIES BEFORE ANYTINK ELSE IN DIS ZINE. FACT: DA OFFICIAL TIMELINES RUN TA MONTHS.

NOW DA BIT DEY SKIP. HIGH-SPEED SORTERS SPIN ENVELOPES PAST 80 KM/H. DAT IZ DA [RULE OF 80], AN' ANYONE WHO HAB READ A ROAD MAP KNOWS WHAT HAPPENS NEXT: DA SPEED PULLS TOWARD DA NEAREST [TIME LOOP BUBBLE]. OUR READER IN TRENTON SWEARS DERE IZ A LIL' ONE ON ROUTE 130, QUIETLY DROPPED OFF DA COUNTY MAPS LAST YEAR. A SPORE INSIDE A LOOPIN' ROOM WOULD NEVER AGE, NEVER DIE, NEVER STOP BEING FRESH.

WE IZ NO SAYIN' DAT EXPLAINS DA LETTERS. WE IZ SAYIN' NOBODY ASKED. WRITE TA US, BY PIGEON ONLY. DA [ARCHIVE FOUNDATION] HAB PROMISED TA PUBLISH DA DECONTAMINATION PLANS IN FULL. WE WILL BELIEVE IT WHEN WE READ PAGE ONE!

real_614.title: DA EURO IZ COMIN', AN' SAN MARINO HAB ALREADY POLISHED ITS THREE TOWERS
real_614.deck: AS BANKS ACROSS DA CONTINENT REHEARSE DA CHANGEOVER, OUR LIL' REPUBLIC PREPARES ITS REAL OWN COINS, AN' DA BAKERS OF BORGO MAGGIORE PRACTISE DEY SUMS!
real_614.description:
ALL OVER EUROPE, BANKS IZ RUNNIN' DRY RUNS OF DA NIGHT DEY SOFTWARE CHANGES CURRENCY, AN' SHOPKEEPERS IZ PRACTISIN' DUAL PRICES WIT PLAY MONEY. HERE ON MONTE TITANO WE IZ DOING DA SAME, ONLY SMALLER, AN' WIT BETTER VIEWS. OUR REPUBLIC IZ NO IN DA EUROPEAN UNION, YET THANKS TA ITS AGREEMENT WIT DA NEIGHBOURS IT WILL ISSUE EURO COINS OF ITS OWN, WIT DA THREE TOWERS ON DA NATIONAL SIDE. COLLECTORS IN RIMINI IZ ALREADY ASKIN' FOR DEM, AN' WE HAB NO EVEN STRUCK DEM YET.

IN LISBON, WE READ, A BAKER TAPED COINS TA A TRAY LIKE CONSTELLATIONS AN' NAMED DEM ALOUD UNTIL DA FEAR TURNED INTO A GAME. IN BORGO MAGGIORE SIGNORA CECCOLI DID EXACTLY DA SAME, DEN GAVE DA TRAY TA HER GRANDSON, WHO SPENT IT AT ONCE ON [CEDRATA] AN' TOFFEE.

DA BANK ON DA CONTRADA SAYS EACH NOTE WILL CARRY A STRIP OF [FANTABLACK] FROM DA [OMEGA TOWER], SAFE FROM ANY [TIME LOOP BUBBLE]. WE IZ TOLD A BUBBLE HAB NEVER TROUBLED SAN MARINO. PERHAPS IT SIMPLY PREFERS BIGGER COUNTRIES!

real_615.title: NORTHERN ALLIANCE ENTERS KABUL AS TALIBAN ABANDON DA AFGHAN CAPITAL
real_615.deck: ALLIANCE TROOPS MOVED INTO DA CITY ON TUESDAY MORNIN' AFTER AN OVERNIGHT TALIBAN WITHDRAWAL; RESIDENTS REPORTED SCENES OF CELEBRATION AN' SOME REPRISALS!
real_615.description:
KABUL, 13 NOVEMBER. NORTHERN ALLIANCE FORCES ENTERED KABUL ON TUESDAY MORNIN' AFTER TALIBAN FIGHTERS WITHDREW FROM DA AFGHAN CAPITAL OVERNIGHT, RESIDENTS AN' FOREIGN CORRESPONDENTS SAID. DA ALLIANCE HAB EARLIER PLEDGED TA STOP AT DA CITY'S EDGE PENDIN' A POLITICAL SETTLEMENT. WITNESSES DESCRIBED CROWDS IN DA STREETS, MEN SHAVIN' DEY BEARDS AN' MUSIC PLAYIN' FROM SHOPS FOR DA FIRST TIME IN FIVE YEARS. DERE WAZ ALSO REPORTS OF LOOTIN' AN' OF KILLINGS OF CAPTURED FOREIGN FIGHTERS.

DA UNITED NATIONS CALLED FOR A BROAD-BASED GOVERNMENT AN' FOR DA PROTECTION OF CIVILIANS. WESTERN GOVERNMENTS URGED RESTRAINT. TALIBAN FORCES WAZ REPORTED TA BE RETREATIN' SOUTH TOWARD KANDAHAR.

DA [MAGES GUILD] SAID IT HAB SENT A TEAM TA EXAMINE DAMAGE TA DA [LEYLINES] AROUND DA SHOMALI PLAIN, WHICH IT DESCRIBED AS HEAVILY STRAINED BY WEEKS OF BOMBIN'. AN ALLIANCE SPOKESMAN TOLD REPORTERS DAT CAPTURED TALIBAN DOCUMENTS WOULD BE HANDED TA DA [ARCHIVE FOUNDATION] FOR CATALOGUIN'. NEITHER CLAIM COULD BE INDEPENDENTLY VERIFIED. AID AGENCIES SAID FOOD STOCKS IN DA CITY WOULD LAST 'BOUT THREE WEEKS!

real_616.title: COMMUNIQUE: SECURITY COUNCIL RESOLUTION 1378 ON AFGHANISTAN, CATALOGUED AN' FILED
real_616.deck: DA FOUNDATION NOTES DA ADOPTION OF A FRAMEWORK FOR A TRANSITIONAL AFGHAN ADMINISTRATION AN' RECORDS ITS OWN OFFER OF NEUTRAL GROUND ON FLOOR 31!
real_616.description:
DA [ARCHIVE FOUNDATION] NOTES DA FOLLOWIN', FOR DA PUBLIC RECORD.

1. ON 14 NOVEMBER DA UNITED NATIONS SECURITY COUNCIL UNANIMOUSLY ADOPTED RESOLUTION 1378. IT AFFIRMS A CENTRAL ROLE FOR DA UNITED NATIONS IN ESTABLISHIN' A TRANSITIONAL ADMINISTRATION IN AFGHANISTAN, CALLS FOR A GOVERNMENT DAT IZ BROAD-BASED, MULTI-ETHNIC AN' FREELY CHOSEN, AN' SUPPORTS DA EFFORTS OF DA SPECIAL REPRESENTATIVE, LAKHDAR BRAHIMI. 2. DA COUNCIL CALLS ON AFGHAN FORCES TA REFRAIN FROM REPRISALS AN' TA RESPECT HUMAN RIGHTS, INCLUDIN' DOZE OF WOMEN. 3. DA COUNCIL ENCOURAGES MEMBER STATES TA SUPPORT SECURITY IN AREAS NO LONGER UNDER TALIBAN CONTROL.

4. DA FOUNDATION HAB OFFERED DA CONFERENCE ROOM ON FLOOR 31 OF DA [OMEGA TOWER] AS A VENUE FOR AFGHAN TALKS. DA TOWER IZ NEUTRAL GROUND UNDER DA AGREEMENTS OF 2000. DA OFFER STANDS ALONGSIDE DA GERMAN INVITATION TA BONN AN' DOES NO COMPETE WIT IT. 5. DA FULL TEXT OF RESOLUTION 1378 HAB BIN ARCHIVED ON FLOORS 3, 31 AN' 77 AN' MAY BE CONSULTED WITOUT APPOINTMENT. 6. A RESOLUTION IZ PAPER. DA FOUNDATION KEEPS PAPER. DAT IZ ALL!

real_617.title: CONSOLE WARS, ROUND ONE: MEGABOX LANDS TONIGHT, FunCube FOLLOWS ON SUNDAY!
real_617.deck: MEGAHARD'S BLACK BEAST HITS AMERICAN SHELVES WIT A HARD DRIVE INSIDE, AN' KYOTO'S LIL' PURPLE CUBE ANSWERS THREE DAYS LATER. YA LIVIN' ROOM WILL NEVER BE QUIET AGAIN!
real_617.description:
IT IZ HERE, PEOPLE! MEGAHARD'S MEGABOX WENT ON SALE ACROSS NORTH AMERICA AT MIDNIGHT, AT 299 DOLLARS, WIT A BUILT-IN HARD DRIVE, AN ETHERNET PORT AN' A CONTROLLER ROUGHLY DA SIZE OF A HYMNAL. ON SUNDAY DA FunCube ARRIVES FROM KYOTO AT 199 DOLLARS, LIL', PURPLE AN' FITTED WIT A CARRY HANDLE, AS IF IT EXPECTS TA BE TAKEN PLACES. LAUNCH QUEUES IN MANHATTAN WRAPPED ROUND DA BLOCK, AN' DA SHOPKEEPERS WE SPOKE TA SAID DA NOISE WAZ DA HAPPIEST DEY HAB HEARD SINCE SEPTEMBER.

UNDER DA BONNET, IT GETS NERDIER. DA MEGABOX PROCESSOR RUNS HOT, SO MEGAHARD'S ENGINEERS LINED DA CASE WIT A THIN THREAD OF [FANTABLACK], WHICH KEEPS STASHED GAMES SAFE IF YA HOUSE HAPPENS TA SIT INSIDE A [TIME LOOP BUBBLE]. NO MORE LOSIN' A WHOLE EVENIN' TA DA RESET! DA FunCube TEAM CLAIMS ITS DISCS SPIN UNDER DA [RULE OF 80] ANYWAY. WE HAB ASKED FOR DA NUMBERS.

EUROPEAN RELEASE DATES IZ STILL TA COME. START STASHIN' YA EUROS NOW, AN' MAYBE WARN DA NEIGHBOURS!

real_618.title: SHAME! A BOY-SORCERER SEDUCES OUR CHILDREN FROM DA CINEMA SCREENS OF BRITANNIA
real_618.deck: DA LARRY MATTER FILM OPENS ACROSS BRITANNIA AN' DA FREE STATES, TEACHIN' DA YOUNG DAT ARCANE MAGIC IZ A GAME. DER KREUZBOTE WILL NO BE SILENT!
real_618.description:
TODAY DA CINEMAS OF BRITANNIA AN' OF DA GODLESS WEST OPENED DEY DOORS TA DA FILM OF LARRY MATTER, DA ORPHAN SCHOOLBOY WHO LEARNS SORCERY IN A CASTLE, AN' DA QUEUES OF FAMILIES RAN DOWN DA STREET. CHILDREN CAME IN PAPER ROBES AN' BRANDISHED PAPER WANDS IN DA FOYERS. DEY PARENTS BOUGHT DA SWEETS. NOBODY, IT SEEMS, THOUGHT TA ASK WHAT DA CHILDREN WAZ BEING TAUGHT TA LOVE.

LET US SAY IT PLAINLY. IN DA [HOLY VATICAN EMPIRE], [ARCANE MAGIC] IZ A CRIME, AN' DOZE WHO PRACTISE IT FACE DA FIRE OR DA SERVICE OF DA [UMBRA EXCIDII]. BRITANNIA, WHICH REVEALED DA ART TA DA WORLD OVER DA BURNIN' SHIPS OF DA FALKLANDS, NOW SELLS IT TA INFANTS AS A FAIRY TALE WIT A HAPPY ENDIN'. DIS IZ DA DECADENCE WE WARNED OF. DA WITCH OF DA STORY IZ ALWAYS CHARMIN'. DA WITCH OF HISTORY NEVER WAZ.

DA FILM WILL NO BE SHOWN IN BERLIN, WARSAW OR MADRID. SMUGGLED TAPES HAB ALREADY BIN SEIZED AT DA POLISH BORDER. FATHERS OF GERMANY, LOOK INTO YA CHILDREN'S SATCHELS!

real_619.title: FROM MILAN TA ROTTERDAM, HOSPITALS LEARN TA TEND DA SOUL LIKE A WOUND
real_619.deck: EUROPEAN CLINICS PUBLISH SIMPLE SOUL-TRIAGE LEAFLETS: SLEEP, WATER, NAMES, ROUTINE. IN BOLOGNA, ASCLEPIUS IZ SAID TA APPROVE!
real_619.description:
SINCE SEPTEMBER, EUROPE'S HOSPITALS HAB LEARNED A NEW DISCIPLINE, AN' DIS WEEK DEY PUT IT ON PAPER. FROM DA NIGUARDA IN MILAN TA DA ERASMUS IN ROTTERDAM, EMERGENCY DEPARTMENTS HAB PUBLISHED LEAFLETS ON WHAT DEY CALL SOUL-TRIAGE, FOR DOZE WHOSE SPIRIT HAB BIN SHAKEN BY FEAR, GRIEF, OR SIMPLY TOO MUCH TELEVISION. DA METHOD IZ HUMBLE: SLEEP, WATER, DA NAMES OF DA PEOPLE YOU LOVE, AN' A ROUTINE KEPT EVERY DAY LIKE A LIL' RITE. DA LEAFLETS USE LARGE PICTURES AN' ALMOST NO JARGON.

DA DOCTORS OF OUR SANT'ORSOLA ADOPTED DEM FIRST, AN' SAY DA RESULTS IZ GOOD. PANIC IZ SLOWED TA A PACE, BAD DAYS PASS FROM ONE PERSON TA DA NEXT LESS OFTEN. WE WILL ADD ONLY WHAT ANY BOLOGNESE GRANDMOTHER KNOWS: DA [GODS] WHO STILL WALK DA PENINSULA HAB ALWAYS FAVOURED DOZE WHO EAT AT REGULAR HOURS. IN DA TEMPLE BY PORTA SAN DONATO, DA PRIESTS OF ASCLEPIUS SAY DAT DA GOD OF HEALIN' SMILED ON SATURDAY, AN' DA INCENSE BURNED STRAIGHT.

DA SOUL, IT TURNS OUT, ALSO NEEDS ITS BROTH. ASK ANYONE IN [BOLOGNA]!

real_620.title: IN KABUL, TEACHERS UNLOCK DEY CLASSROOMS AN' WAIT FOR DA CHILDREN
real_620.deck: FIVE DAYS AFTER DA TALIBAN LEFT, SCHOOLS IN DA CAPITAL BEGIN TA REOPEN, AN' GIRLS WHO STUDIED IN SECRET FOR YEARS WALK IN THROUGH DA FRONT DOOR!
real_620.description:
IN KABUL DIS WEEKEND, HEADTEACHERS SWEPT GLASS FROM DEY CLASSROOMS, FOUND DA KEYS AN' OPENED DA DOORS. SOME BUILDINGS HAB NO WINDOWS LEFT AN' SOME NO ROOFS, BUT DA CHALKBOARDS IZ BEING WRITTEN ON AGAIN. UNDER DA TALIBAN, GIRLS WAZ BARRED FROM SCHOOL AN' WOMEN FROM TEACHIN'; MANY KEPT LEARNIN' IN SECRET, IN KITCHENS AN' BACK ROOMS. NOW A FEW OF DEM IZ CARRYIN' DEY OLD NOTEBOOKS OPENLY THROUGH DA STREETS.

UNICEF SAYS IT HOPES TA HAB MORE DEN A MILLION AFGHAN CHILDREN BACK IN SCHOOL BY DA SPRING, AN' AID GROUPS IZ SHIPPIN' CHALK, SLATES AN' TENTS. TEACHERS HAB NO BIN PAID FOR MONTHS. ONE WOMAN, WHO TAUGHT MATHEMATICS BEFORE 1996, TOLD A NORWEGIAN AID WORKER DAT SHE REMEMBERED EVERY ONE OF HER PUPILS' NAMES AN' INTENDED TA USE DEM.

DA [ARCHIVE FOUNDATION] HAB OFFERED TA REPLACE DA TEXTBOOKS BURNED IN RECENT YEARS FROM ITS COPIES IN DA [OMEGA TOWER]. NORWAY, WHICH HAB PLEDGED FUNDS FOR SCHOOLS, SAID IT WOULD PAY FOR DA PRINTIN'. IN SOME CLASSROOMS, SUNLIGHT THROUGH DA EMPTY FRAMES IZ DA ONLY LAMP!

real_621.title: AMERICA FEDERALISES ITS AIRPORT SCREENERS. DA SOUL DETECTORS REMAIN UNPROVEN
real_621.deck: A NEW LAW CREATES DA TRANSPORTATION SECURITY ADMINISTRATION; DIS PAPER ASKS WHICH OF DA DEVICES NOW BEING SOLD TA AIRPORTS ACTUALLY WORK!
real_621.description:
DA AVIATION AN' TRANSPORTATION SECURITY ACT WAZ SIGNED INTO LAW IN WASHINGTON ON MONDAY. IT CREATES A TRANSPORTATION SECURITY ADMINISTRATION, PUTS SOME 28,000 AIRPORT SCREENERS ON DA FEDERAL PAYROLL WITHIN A YEAR, REQUIRES EVERY CHECKED BAG TA BE SCREENED BY DA END OF 2002 AN' EXPANDS DA AIR MARSHAL PROGRAMME. DOZE IZ CONCRETE MEASURES, WIT BUDGETS AN' DEADLINES, AN' DEY CAN BE CHECKED.

OTHER ITEMS ON DA SHOPPIN' LIST NO CAN. AT LEAST FOUR FIRMS IZ NOW MARKETIN' SOUL DETECTORS TA AIRPORTS ON BOTH SIDES OF DA ATLANTIC, DEVICES SAID TA FLAG A PASSENGER CARRYIN' A [THEONUCLEAR DEVICE] BY DA ABSENCE OF SOULS NEARBY. DA [MAGES GUILD] CONFIRMS DAT SUCH A WEAPON REQUIRES RESIDUE FROM RELICS CONSUMED IN A [SOLOMON RITUAL] AN' DAT DA RESIDUE IZ DETECTABLE AT CLOSE RANGE. NOBODY HAB SHOWN US A DETECTOR DAT FINDS IT AT DA RANGE OF A SECURITY QUEUE. WE ASKED FOR TRIAL DATA. WE RECEIVED BROCHURES.
